opening.argument: The presentation solicits paid participation in a Forsage BUSD project while tying income to teams, uplines, downlines, referrals, and slot levels. Entry requires payment through a crypto wallet, and the speaker says, “Your own team will bring your income, and your income will come from up line, down line cross line this slot will run automatically.” It then presents a “1120 percent” benefit, urging viewers that “you have to earn more than 10 times,” while directing them to buy another slot when a stated symbol appears. The structure therefore relies on recruitment-linked participation and repeated slot purchases alongside very large projected earnings. The records do not establish that any payout occurred or that these figures were independently verified.
